title: Goitein on the Indian route, Genizah Fragments 21
authors: Cambridge University Library, Taylor–Schechter Genizah Research Unit
lineage: Institutional newsletter reproducing S. D. Goitein’s retrospective of his document research, rather than the original court records.

passages.note: Goitein describes eleven court sessions between 1097 and 1098 concerning Joseph Lebdi’s India journey with goods entrusted by other merchants, many lost in shipwreck.

file.method: Brief paraphrase of passages actually inspected.
